title: Staying Awake Too Long = A Drunk Brain 🍺
caption:
Staying awake too long can hit your brain like alcohol.

After 17–19 hours awake, people scored as badly as, or worse than, someone at 0.05% blood alcohol on some tests. And 6 hours a night for 2 weeks did as much damage as skipping 1–2 whole nights, while people said they felt fine.

Which level of tired are you on right now? 👇
